_about: v79.14.1 (item 8): §5's relevance test (src/rag/rulings.py:passage_names_institution). A ruling's quoted passage stays in §5 only when its sentence names the record's institution, by any of: (1) the record's article cited by its number («art. 646», «646 c.p.», «612 bis», «612-bis»); (2) the institution's name -- the first content noun of the record's rubrica that is not in `generic_stems`, as a root (rulings.relevance_stems: the word without its inflection and its «-zione / -sione / -mento» suffix, so «Estorsione» -> «estors-» meets «estorsiva», «Diffamazione» -> «diffama-» meets «diffamatoria»; «Appropriazione indebita» -> «appropria-», «Rissa» -> «riss-»); (3) at least `rubrica_stems_min` of the rubrica's other non-generic roots together, each met by a different word of the passage -- one alone of a several-word rubrica never (the «indebito» of a credit card's «indebito utilizzo» is not appropriazione indebita); (4) one of the record's own words below (`aliases`: label -> word stems, matched at a word's start; an entry of several stems separated by a space needs all of them: «artifici induc») -- the institution's other names and the nouns of its defining element (582 c.p.: «lesion-», «malatti-»). `generic_stems`: rubrica words that name no institution alone -- never the name of rule (2), never counted in rule (3) («esercizio», «attività», «cagionato», «beni immobili», «reali», «risarcimento», «garanzia»: a passage on a misura cautelare reale or on contractual damages is not on usucapione or on the illecito aquiliano). A passage that names none is dropped with its ruling (it is no ruling on the record), counted (rulings_passage_irrelevant_dropped); a ruling printed with its estremi alone has no sentence to test (its abstract passed the rubrica test, rulings.on_rubrica) and stays; a record with no rubrica root and no alias is not tested.
